title: 骨头里为什么有空气 · 素材
subtitle: 给对比页用的单体素材
style: children's picture book illustration, fine pen and ink lines with light watercolour washes, teal green, pale grey blue and warm cream

pages.scene: One single length of metal bicycle frame tube standing upright, cut straight across at the top so that the thin wall and the empty middle show. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges.
One single large pale bone standing alone, one deep round opening in its side. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges.

One single pigeon standing on two feet, seen from the side facing left, its whole body inside the picture. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges.
